children: DA Davidson maintained their Buy rating on MongoDB's stock with a price target of $415.00.
The price target implies an upside of 23.1% from the Sep 29 close of $337.19.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: DA Davidson believes that MongoDB will maintain a durable growth rate of over 20% and a Rule-of-40+ profile, indicating a healthy balance between growth and profitability, which supports a bullish outlook on the company's stock.

: The recent launch of MongoDB 9.0 and Atlas Infinite, which enhance performance and scalability, positions the company to better meet customer needs and capitalize on emerging AI workloads, thus reinforcing investor confidence in sustained revenue growth.
Across the five most recent analyst notes published on MDB over the past 30 days, price targets range from $375 to $560.
